rationale: With only 25 minutes to close and the stock sitting at 95.1% of its intraday range near the session high ($62.85), the risk/reward for a long is poor — minimal upside before the high acts as resistance and forced liquidation at close creates execution risk. A short against a strong earnings-driven momentum day with SPY up 2.62% and VIXY down 13.39% is equally unattractive. The wide bid-ask spread (57.6 bps) and consolidating 1-minute candles with declining volume suggest the move is exhausted but not reversing cleanly enough to justify a short entry with a defined stop.
